SELECT count(1) FROM xxl_job_role AS t
AND t.name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{name}), '%')
AND t.code like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{code}), '%')
AND t.status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_job_role ( name, code, status, old_role, add_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{code}, #{status}, #{oldRole}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime} );
mapper.update: UPDATE xxl_job_role SET name = #{name}, code = #{code}, status = #{status}, old_role = #{oldRole}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM xxl_job_role AS t WHERE t.status = 1 ORDER BY add_time ASC
SELECT FROM xxl_job_role AS t WHERE t.old_role = #{oldRole} AND t.status = 1
